title: Dependency and composition definitions
description: Shared dependency definitions (F2-02, schema-strategy). NON-NORMATIVE machine artifact: the normative source is spec/core/dependencies.md. `extends` is an ordered list whose order is significant for precedence and MUST be preserved by the resolver.

dependencyReference.description: One entry of the ordered `extends` array. `extends` order is significant: an explicit declaration in the extending artifact outranks a dependency named earlier, which outranks a dependency named later. F1: core/dependencies.md §2, §4.

reference.description: Dependency reference: a scoped reference '@owner/slug[@version]' or a canonical identifier 'https://<host>/h/<owner>/<slug>[@<version>]'. A short reference 'owner/slug' MUST NOT be used inside a published manifest because it carries no host. An unpinned reference MUST be resolved to an immutable digest before Apply. F1: core/dependencies.md §1.

override.description: Optional explicit override of a dependency declaration. The precise surface syntax of override declarations is OPEN (decision record §58, open question 'dependencies and composition'); this position is permissive. An override MUST be explicit in the extending artifact, MUST be visible in the Install Plan, and MUST NOT reduce a risk class, broaden a scope without approval or bypass a security constraint. F1: core/dependencies.md §6, §8.
